projects.name: FloodSentinel
projects.summary: A Sri Lanka flood-scenario dashboard connecting district maps, live weather data and a machine-learning pipeline.
projects.details: An academic team project covering 25 Sri Lankan districts, weather ingestion, scenario exploration and seven-day projections. The project README credits Gamitha with the frontend geospatial map and full ML lifecycle.
projects.contribution: Frontend geospatial map and full ML lifecycle (team project)
projects.caveat: The model is trained on synthetic scenarios. It is not an official warning system or a verified measure of real-world flood probability.

projects.name: Aurora LMS
projects.summary: A learning platform bringing quizzes, live quiz rooms, notes and flashcards into one role-based experience.
projects.details: Separate administrator, lecturer and student workflows connect a React frontend to a TypeScript REST API. Features include quiz attempts, flashcard decks, notes, room participation and performance views.

projects.name: RESQ
projects.summary: A disaster-response command portal for mapping incidents, coordinating teams and managing digital evidence.
projects.details: An enterprise cloud architecture project with a React command portal, Spring-based domain services, service discovery, an API gateway and Terraform infrastructure definitions. Includes incident workflows, team allocation and evidence management.

projects.name: Aurora Mobile
projects.summary: A mobile study companion for organizing notes, reviewing flashcards and keeping learning close at hand.
projects.details: An Expo and React Native app with Firebase authentication, notes, flashcard study sessions, light and dark themes, and Redux Toolkit state management.

projects.name: GuestFind
projects.summary: A hotel lost-and-found platform that takes items from initial report through claim approval and delivery.
projects.details: Role-based workflows for administrators, hotel staff and guests, with item reporting, matching, claims, delivery management, notifications and statistics. A Spring Boot REST backend supports the HTML, CSS and JavaScript frontend.

screenshots.label: GuestFind landing page (README labels this Dashboard)

projects.name: Automated Greenhouse
projects.summary: A distributed greenhouse management system connecting telemetry, automation rules and crop lifecycle tracking.
projects.details: Four domain services manage zones, sensor data, automation actions and crops. A service registry, central configuration server and API gateway coordinate the system.

projects.name: ISO 8583 Toolkit
projects.summary: Android experiments for decoding payment messages and simulating a POS-to-switch request-and-response flow.
projects.details: The parser displays message headers, MTI and data elements using jPOS. The separate simulator constructs a sale request and exchanges it with a local switch server over TCP.
projects.caveat: Described as experiments and simulation, not a certified payment processor or production payment product.

projects.name: Serenity
projects.summary: A desktop administration application for patients, therapists, therapy sessions and payment records.
projects.details: A JavaFX coursework application with controllers for patient registration, therapist and program management, therapy sessions, payments, users and role-specific dashboards. Maven dependencies verify Hibernate, MySQL and JasperReports integration.
